text: Figure 1.2: AUTOSAR Signal Nomenclature The main purpose of FlexRay T ransport Protocol is to perform a transfer of a message (I-PDU) that e.g. might or might not fit in a single FlexRay L-PDU. I-PDUs that do not fit into a single FlexRay L-PDU are segmented into multiple parts, where each can be transmitted in a FlexRay L-PDU. According to AUTOSAR basic software architecture, the FlexRay T ransport Protocol provides methods for • Segmentation of data in transmit direction • Reassembling of data in receive direction • Control of data flow • Error detection in segmentation sessions • T ransmit cancellation It is an AUTOSAR decision to base basic software module specifications on existing standards, thus this AUTOSAR FlexRay T ransport Layer specification is based on the international standard [1].
